## Professional Summary

4th-year Data Science & AI Engineering student at École Polytechnique de Sousse (graduating 2026), specialising in LLM integration , RAG systems , and NLP pipelines . Proven experience building end-to-end AI products: a RAG-based legal document assistant (LangChain, ChromaDB, FastAPI, Groq LLaMA 3.3 70B), a multimodal MDD detection pipeline (PyTorch, EEG + speech), and a deployed football outcome predictor (XGBoost, Streamlit Cloud). Targeting AI/ML Engineering roles in agentic AI, applied NLP, and intelligent text analytics.

## LegalMind v2 - RAG-Based Legal Document Assistant

Python · LangChain · ChromaDB · FastAPI · Groq LLaMA 3.3 70B · Streamlit · Docker In Progress

- Building a production-ready RAG pipeline for legal PDF Q&A: PyMuPDF ingestion, RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter (chunk 1000/overlap 100), all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings, ChromaDB vector store (K=4), BGE reranker, and Groq LLaMA 3.3 70B generation.
- Implementing evaluation with DeepEval + golden Q&A dataset; observability via Langfuse.
- Fully containerised with Docker (multi-service: FastAPI backend + Streamlit frontend) with health checks and environment isolation.

## Multimodal MDD Detection - EEG & Speech AI

Python · PyTorch · Scikit-learn · Signal Processing · Hugging Face

- Designed a full CRISP-DM pipeline classifying Major Depressive Disorder using EEG + speech data (MODMA dataset); subject-level stratified 5-fold CV preventing data leakage.
- Built three PyTorch architectures: EEGNetLite, AudioCNN (log-mel spectrograms), and FusionMLP (late fusion). Benchmarked against LR, SVM-RBF, and Random Forest baselines.
- EEG preprocessing: 128-channel band-pass/notch filtering, ICA artifact removal, epoch segmentation. Audio: VAD, MFCC & log-mel feature extraction. Deployed interface on Hugging Face Spaces.

## Football Match Outcome Predictor

Python · Scikit-learn · XGBoost · Streamlit · Pandas · Git

- Trained and compared Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost on ∼ 130,000 historical matches; engineered features (ELO ratings, team form, implied probabilities from betting odds).
- Vectorised Monte Carlo simulation for season/UCL predictions (Arsenal PL: 99.1%, UCL: 31.8%). Deployed publicly on Streamlit Cloud via Git-based CI/CD.

## AI Fashion Advisor - Smart Wardrobe Application

Flutter · Dart · Google Gemini API · Open-Meteo API

- Flutter mobile app integrating Gemini Vision API for clothing analysis and AI-generated outfit recommendations contextualised by real-time GPS weather data.

- Features: multi-select wardrobe with FilterChips, occasion picker, outfit rating system, dark/light theme persistence. Tested and deployed on real Android device.

## E-Commerce Microservices Platform

Node.js · gRPC · GraphQL · Kafka 4.x · MongoDB · Docker

- End-to-end microservices architecture with REST, GraphQL, and gRPC inter-service communication; event streaming via Kafka 4.x; fully containerised with Docker Compose.
